notes: Power level is now tracked per difficulty. A new 'Power by difficulty' popup row shows your DPS in each difficulty you've run - Reaper 10 down to Reaper 1, Elite, Normal, Casual, epic/legendary variants, and Out of Quest - hardest first. Difficulty detection also fixed: it now reads the dungeon portal (which actually works on live) instead of the dead character-side properties, so the reaper-skull normalisation and the Quest Difficulty row work too.
